verses.original: Μὴ ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία ταρασσέσθω πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν Θεόν πιστεύετε εἰς ἐμὲ καὶ
verses.transliteration: Mē hymōn hē kardia tarassesthō pisteuete eis ton Theon pisteuete eis eme kai
verses.literal: {Do} not {let} your - hearts be troubled You believe in - God believe in Me as well

verses.original: ἐν μου τοῦ Πατρός τῇ οἰκίᾳ εἰσιν πολλαί μοναὶ δὲ εἰ μή ἂν εἶπον ὑμῖν ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: en mou tou Patros tē oikia eisin pollai monai de ei mē an eipon hymin hoti poreuomai hetoimasai topon hymin
verses.literal: In My - Father’s - house are many rooms - If [it were] not so would I have told you that I am going [there] to prepare a place for you

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τόπον ὑμῖν ἔρχομαι πάλιν καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν ἵνα ὑμεῖς καὶ ἦτε ὅπου ἐγὼ εἰμὶ
verses.transliteration: kai ean poreuthō kai hetoimasō topon hymin erchomai palin kai paralēmpsomai hymas pros emauton hina hymeis kai ēte hopou egō eimi
verses.literal: And if I go and prepare a place for you I will come back and welcome you into My presence so that you also may be where I am

verses.original: καὶ οἴδατε τὴν ὁδόν ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω
verses.transliteration: kai oidate tēn hodon hopou egō hypagō
verses.literal: - You know the way to the place where I am going

verses.original: Κύριε Λέγει Θωμᾶς αὐτῷ οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις πῶς δυνάμεθα εἰδέναι τὴν ὁδὸν
verses.transliteration: Kyrie Legei Thōmas autō ouk oidamen pou hypageis pōs dynametha eidenai tēn hodon
verses.literal: Lord said Thomas - vvv we do not know where You are going [so] how can we know the way

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα εἰ μὴ δι’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autō Egō eimi hē hodos kai hē alētheia kai hē zōē oudeis erchetai pros ton Patera ei mē di’ emou
verses.literal: - Jesus answered - I am the way and the truth and the life No one comes to the Father except . . . through Me

verses.original: εἰ ἐγνώκειτέ με καὶ ᾔδειτε μου τὸν Πατέρα ἂν ἀπ’ ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ei egnōkeite me kai ēdeite mou ton Patera an ap’ arti ginōskete auton kai heōrakate auton
verses.literal: If you had known Me - you would know My - Father as well From now on you do know Him and have seen Him

verses.original: Φίλιππος Λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Philippos Legei autō Kyrie deixon hēmin ton Patera kai arkei hēmin
verses.literal: Philip said to Him Lord show us the Father and that will be enough for us

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππε εἰμι μεθ’ ὑμῶν Τοσούτῳ χρόνῳ καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν Πατέρα πῶς σὺ λέγεις Δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autō Philippe eimi meth’ hymōn Tosoutō chronō kai ouk egnōkas me ho heōrakōs eme heōraken ton Patera pōs sy legeis Deixon hēmin ton Patera
verses.literal: - Jesus replied . . . Philip I have been with you all this time and vvv still you do not know Me Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father How {can} you say Show us the Father

verses.original: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐστιν ἐν ἐμοί τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν οὐ λαλῶ ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ δὲ ὁ Πατὴρ μένων ἐν ἐμοὶ ποιεῖ αὐτοῦ τὰ ἔργα
verses.transliteration: ou pisteueis hoti egō en tō Patri kai ho Patēr estin en emoi ta rhēmata ha egō legō hymin ou lalō ap’ emautou de ho Patēr menōn en emoi poiei autou ta erga
verses.literal: vvv Do you not believe that I [am] in the Father and the Father is in Me The words - I say to you vvv I do not speak on My own Instead {it is} the Father dwelling in Me performing His - works

verses.original: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί δὲ εἰ μή πιστεύετε διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ
verses.transliteration: pisteuete moi hoti egō en tō Patri kai ho Patēr en emoi de ei mē pisteuete dia ta erga auta
verses.literal: Believe Me that I [am] in the Father and the Father [is] in Me or at least . . . . . . believe on account of the works themselves

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ποιήσει καὶ μείζονα τούτων ὅτι ἐγὼ πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin ho pisteuōn eis eme kakeinos poiēsei ta erga ha egō poiō poiēsei kai meizona toutōn hoti egō poreuomai pros ton Patera
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you whoever believes in Me vvv will also do the works that I am doing He will do even greater [things] than these because I am going to the Father

verses.original: καὶ τοῦτο ποιήσω ὅ¦τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ μου ὀνόματί ἵνα ὁ Πατὴρ δοξασθῇ ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ
verses.transliteration: kai touto poiēsō ho¦ti an aitēsēte en tō mou onomati hina ho Patēr doxasthē en tō Huiō
verses.literal: And - I will do whatever . . . you ask in - My name so that the Father may be glorified in the Son

verses.original: ἐάν αἰτήσητέ με τι ἐν μου τῷ ὀνόματί ἐγὼ ποιήσω
verses.transliteration: ean aitēsēte me ti en mou tō onomati egō poiēsō
verses.literal: If you ask Me for anything in My - name I will do [it]

verses.original: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με τηρήσετε τὰς ἐμὰς τὰς ἐντολὰς
verses.transliteration: Ean agapate me tērēsete tas emas tas entolas
verses.literal: If you love Me you will keep - My - commandments

verses.original: Κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν Πατέρα καὶ δώσει ὑμῖν ἄλλον Παράκλητον ἵνα ᾖ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: Kagō erōtēsō ton Patera kai dōsei hymin allon Paraklēton hina ē meth’ hymōn eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: And I will ask the Father and He will give you another Advocate to be with you vvv vvv forever

verses.original: τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν ὃ ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ γινώσκει ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό ὅτι μένει παρ’ ὑμῖν καὶ ἔσται ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: to Pneuma tēs alētheias ho kosmos ou dynatai labein ho hoti ou theōrei auto oude ginōskei hymeis ginōskete auto hoti menei par’ hymin kai estai en hymin
verses.literal: the Spirit - of truth The world vvv cannot receive [Him] because vvv it neither sees Him nor knows [Him] But you do know Him for He abides with you and will be in you

verses.original: Οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ouk aphēsō hymas orphanous erchomai pros hymas
verses.literal: vvv I will not leave you as orphans I will come to you

verses.original: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος θεωρεῖ με οὐκέτι δὲ ὑμεῖς θεωρεῖτέ με ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ ὑμεῖς καὶ ζήσετε
verses.transliteration: eti mikron kai ho kosmos theōrei me ouketi de hymeis theōreite me hoti egō zō hymeis kai zēsete
verses.literal: In a little while - the world will see Me no more but you will see Me Because I live you also will live

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ὑμεῖς γνώσεσθε ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν μου τῷ Πατρί καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: en ekeinē tē hēmera hymeis gnōsesthe hoti egō en mou tō Patri kai hymeis en emoi kagō en hymin
verses.literal: On that - day you will know that I [am] in My - Father and you [are] in Me and I [am] in you

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων μου τὰς ἐντολάς καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με δὲ ὁ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ μου τοῦ Πατρός κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω ἐμαυτόν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: ho echōn mou tas entolas kai tērōn autas ekeinos estin ho agapōn me de ho agapōn me agapēthēsetai hypo mou tou Patros kagō agapēsō auton kai emphanisō emauton autō
verses.literal: Whoever has My - commandments and keeps them - is the [one who] loves Me - The [one who] loves Me will be loved by My - Father and I will love him and reveal Myself to him

verses.original: Ἰούδας οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης Λέγει αὐτῷ Κύριε καὶ τί γέγονεν ὅτι μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν ἡμῖν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: Ioudas ouch ho Iskariōtēs Legei autō Kyrie kai ti gegonen hoti melleis emphanizein seauton hēmin kai ouchi tō kosmō
verses.literal: Judas (not - Iscariot) asked Him Lord - why . . . . . . are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ με τηρήσει μου τὸν λόγον καὶ μου ὁ Πατήρ ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν καὶ ἐλευσόμεθα πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ποιησόμεθα μονὴν παρ’ αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Iēsous Apekrithē kai eipen autō Ean tis agapa me tērēsei mou ton logon kai mou ho Patēr agapēsei auton kai eleusometha pros auton kai poiēsometha monēn par’ autō
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . If anyone loves Me he will keep My - word - My - Father will love him and We will come to him and make Our home with him

verses.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με οὐ τηρεῖ μου τοὺς λόγους καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε ἔστιν οὐκ ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ Πατρός πέμψαντός με
verses.transliteration: ho mē agapōn me ou tērei mou tous logous kai ho logos hon akouete estin ouk emos alla tou Patros pempsantos me
verses.literal: Whoever vvv does not love Me vvv does not keep My - words - The word that you hear is not My own but [it is ] from the Father who sent Me

verses.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν μένων παρ’ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Tauta lelalēka hymin menōn par’ hymin
verses.literal: All this I have spoken to you [while] I am still with you

verses.original: δὲ ὁ Παράκλητος τὸ τὸ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα ὃ ὁ Πατὴρ πέμψει ἐν τῷ μου ὀνόματί ἐκεῖνος διδάξει ὑμᾶς πάντα καὶ ὑμᾶς ὑπομνήσει πάντα ἃ ἐγώ εἶπον ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de ho Paraklētos to to Hagion Pneuma ho ho Patēr pempsei en tō mou onomati ekeinos didaxei hymas panta kai hymas hypomnēsei panta ha egō eipon hymin
verses.literal: But the Advocate the - Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in - My name - will teach you all things and vvv will remind you of everything . . . I have told you

verses.original: Εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν τὴν ἐμὴν εἰρήνην δίδωμι ὑμῖν ἐγὼ οὐ δίδωμι ὑμῖν καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν μὴ ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία ταρασσέσθω μηδὲ δειλιάτω
verses.transliteration: Eirēnēn aphiēmi hymin tēn emēn eirēnēn didōmi hymin egō ou didōmi hymin kathōs ho kosmos didōsin mē hymōn hē kardia tarassesthō mēde deiliatō
verses.literal: Peace I leave with you - My peace I give to you I {do} not give to you as the world gives {Do} not {let} your - hearts be troubled {do} not be afraid

verses.original: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με ἄν ἐχάρητε ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ ἐστιν μείζων μού
verses.transliteration: ēkousate hoti egō eipon hymin Hypagō kai erchomai pros hymas ei ēgapate me an echarēte hoti poreuomai pros ton Patera hoti ho Patēr estin meizōn mou
verses.literal: You heard - Me say - I am going away and I am coming [back] to you If you loved Me vvv you would rejoice that I am going to the Father because the Father is greater than I

verses.original: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: kai nyn eirēka hymin prin genesthai hina hotan genētai pisteusēte
verses.literal: And now I have told you before it happens so that when it does happen you will believe

verses.original: λαλήσω μεθ’ ὑμῶν πολλὰ Οὐκέτι γὰρ ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου ἔρχεται καὶ ἔχει οὐκ οὐδέν ἐν ἐμοὶ
verses.transliteration: lalēsō meth’ hymōn polla Ouketi gar ho archōn tou kosmou erchetai kai echei ouk ouden en emoi
verses.literal: I will {not} speak with you much [longer] for the prince of this world is coming and he has no claim . . . on Me

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ποιῶ οὕτως καὶ καθὼς ὁ Πατὴρ ἐνετείλατο μοι ἵνα ὁ κόσμος γνῷ ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν Πατέρα Ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν
verses.transliteration: all’ poiō houtōs kai kathōs ho Patēr eneteilato moi hina ho kosmos gnō hoti agapō ton Patera Egeiresthe agōmen enteuthen
verses.literal: But I do - - exactly what the Father has commanded Me so that the world may know that I love the Father Get up Let us go on from here
